'''1999 Decipher World Championship Maarten Logghe DS''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Maarten Logghe]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds92.htm AT-STs on Ralltiir], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001029124938/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds92.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Maarten Logghe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Event:''' [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]
